name: MCP Stdio Bridge
summary: Model Context Protocol JSON-RPC 2.0 message framer and stdio transport adapter
description:
## MCP Stdio Bridge

Implements line-delimited and Content-Length framed JSON-RPC 2.0 transport for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and clients communicating over process standard I/O streams.

### Highlights
- Strict JSON-RPC 2.0 request/response/notification framing
- Streaming parser with buffer chunk reassembly
- Request ID matching with Promise callbacks and timeouts
- Zero external runtime dependencies
